scope: 346 general-purpose verb frames across seven non-command tenses; tener subjunctive aligned with its existing first-person examples. No assessment changes.
exceptions: 20 subject-specific constructions retain their subjects; haber stays impersonal; soler stays tú; tener stays yo. Commands retain the reviewed informal singular addressee.
review: Existing frozen Spanish conjugations reused and checked by selected row. All lexical complements screened for subject-dependent adjective and possessive agreement; English inflection and subject-sensitive translations checked. Source checks support grammatical patterns, not independent certification of every generated sentence.
